pages.text: Right-click one vehicle, then the other, to hitch them. The bar glints between clicks; click the same one twice to cancel.

**Trains** link in a line, each to one ahead and one behind, led by a [[locomotive_cart]] (carts) or a [[motorboats|motorboat]] (boats), towing **up to 3**. Carts and boats can't mix. The [[ender_minecart]] and vanilla carts can't link.

Carts link within about 3 blocks and are held just under 2 apart; boats within 4, held 2½ apart.

**Unhitching:** shift + right-click a vehicle with the bar to unhitch it (and those behind) from the one ahead. Breaking a vehicle, or a link pulled too far, drops the bars.

Carts are joined by bronze drawbars that pivot through corners, so trains never jam.

The same bar links [[buoys]].
